112736.bio:
Sounds Of Mayhem (SOM) is a bass music label founded by PhaseOne in 2023. Dedicated to platforming the heaviest sounds in dubstep, metal and beyond. SOM serves as a platform for both rising talent and established names shaping the future of heavy music.


www.soundsofmayhem.com
